{{Player|tom|flag=pl}} |organizer= |sponsor= |type=online |country=Poland |city=Radomsko |venue=Zodiak Hotel |tournaments=4on4, 2on2, 1on1 and FFA |date= |year= |website=qwlan.pl |discord=discord.gg/ZnybKBgEFP |twitch=badsebitv |youtube=badsebitv |teamfirst= |teamsecond= |teamthird= |teamthird2= |team_number= }} ==About== '''QW LAN PL''' is a QuakeWorld LAN party held in Radomsko area (south-central {{FlagNoLink/pl}} '''[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Poland Poland]''') annually since 2016 (then with just 8 participants). The main goal of this event is to meet fellow Quakeworlders, socialize and play QuakeWorld while having pure fun without sweaty tryharding. Since 2020 held in the Zodiak hotel, Radomsko. ==Past Events== * 2025 - [[QW LAN Party Poland 2025]] * 2024 - [[QW LAN Party Poland 2024]] * 2023 - [[QW LAN Party Poland 2023]] * 2022 - [[QW LAN Party Poland 2022]] * 2021 - [[QW LAN Party Poland 2021]] * 2020 - [[QW LAN Party Poland 2020]] * 2019 - QW LAN Party Poland 2019 * 2018 - QW LAN Party Poland 2018 * 2017 - QW LAN Party Poland 2017 * 2016 - QW LAN Party Poland 2016
